svg.title: Drift is not the same as model degradation
svg.desc: All 200 archived synthetic trials: 40 seeds in each of five scenarios. Horizontal axis is maximum feature PSI; vertical axis is reference AUC minus current AUC. Dashed thresholds are PSI 0.20 and AUC drop 0.08. Mean, variance and positive-rate scenarios triggered distribution alerts in 40 of 40 trials each, but no AUC-degradation alerts. Mixed drift triggered both in 40 of 40. No drift triggered neither. Negative AUC drops indicate improved AUC. This is synthetic development evidence, not production monitoring or a locked benchmark.
svg.metadata: Source: outputs/monitoring_benchmark.json; SHA-256: bdfffa3a451fefe6cf8ec0b4a39ea8f36db4ddf75c1e7c85621d574dab037c7a; repository commit: b25bbd7d0f0d589360350e6df8bf5f4391013c7f. Generated by scripts/render_monitoring_evidence.py; no jitter or sampling.

g.text: One marker = one trial. No jitter or sampling.
2,000 rows per independent window · fixed thresholds
Synthetic development evidence — not production risk.
